32.stem: 외국중재판정의 승인 및 집행에 관한 유엔협약(뉴욕협약, 1958)에 관한 내용으로 옳지 않은 것은?
choices: The Geneva Protocol on Arbitration Clauses of 1923 and the Geneva Convention on the Execution of Foreign Arbitral Awards of 1927 shall cease to have effect between Contracting States on their becoming bound and to the extent that they become bound, by this Convention.
